name: cyclomethicone
uses: Use 1.Clean and dry scar area. 2.Cut sheet according to the size and shape of the scar. 3. Peel off the liner from adhesive side of sheet. 4. Apply adhesive side of sheet directly on scar.Apply 4 hours a day for the first two days, 8 hours a day for the next two days, and then increase by 2 hours aday until you can wear it for 24 hours a day. each scar sheet can be used repeatedly and when another new scar patch becomes difficult to clean or paste replace another new scar sheet.
otcwarn: Do not use Do not use on unhealed wounds, infected areas, or acne-prone skin. If you have an open wound. It may disrupt healing and increase the risk of infection. Ask Doctor Stop use and ask a doctor if skin irritation, redness, or other adverse skin reactions occur. Stop Use stop use on skin becomes broken, irritated, or inflamed
